opinions.text: Motion of the cial Master for compensation and reimbursement of expenses granted, and the Special Master is awarded a total of $263,488.89 to be paid equally by the parties. Motion of New York for leave to file Exceptions in excess of the page limitations denied. Motion of the City of New York for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae in excess of the page limitations denied. [For earlier order herein, see, e. g., 520 U. S. 1273.]
